Name: Vibrant Furniture Collection
Author: Dracofly1192
Description:
Hello again!

Are you sick of the drab lifeless furniture?  Are you tired of having limited decor choices?  I know I am.  That's why I made this mod, [b]The Vibrant Furniture Collection[/b].  To give us choices.  To give us color.  To further enhance our gameplay experience (and my other mods).

If you've seen my other mod,[b] The Vibrant Kitchen Collection[/b], you know that I like color, and adding furniture to the newly themed rooms was the next logical step.  So I started with the green for my brother who wanted to do a harvest themed play-through.  The blue will be done soon, with pink, purple, and orange coming in the future.  Maybe more.

For a more complete look, please download my Vibrant Kitchen mod at [url=https://www.nexusmods.com/stardewvalley/mods/4625]https://www.nexusmods.com/stardewvalley/mods/4625[/url].

EDIT:

xnb overwrites no longer needed.  Both of my mods have been updated with content patcher or json assets packs accordingly.  Enjoy!


Toddler paintings made with sprites from Lumisteria's awesome [b]Toddlers like Parents[/b] mod!  You can download her mod at [url=https://www.nexusmods.com/stardewvalley/mods/405]https://www.nexusmods.com/stardewvalley/mods/405[/url].  


Thank you for your interest!




To Install simple drag and drop the files into Stardew Valley/Tilesheets and let it overwrite.

DON'T FORGET TO BACK UP YOUR FILES!

Enjoy! 

And feel free to leave me a comment or request :)
